## #4 Common Samples

### Select Common Samples

```{r}
common = intersect(colnames(expression),rownames(metadata))
paste0(length(common)," samples in common")
```

### Discard Different Samples

```{r}
expression <- expression[, common]

metadata <- metadata[common, ]
```

## #5 Create Expression Set

```{r}
eSet = make_ExpressionSet(
  expression,
  metadata
)
```

## #6 Gene alignment and subtracting control values

```{r}
gene_list <- tAge:::load_gene_list()

groups <- unique(metadata$Group)

by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  
  e <- eSet[, metadata$Group == g]
  
  e <- tAge:::.align_to_gene_list(
    e,
    gene_list
  )
  
  tAge:::control_subtraction(
    e,
    column_name = "Intervention",
    control_label = "Control",
    verbose = TRUE
  )
})
```

### Bind all the groups in one file

```{r}
eSet_diff <- tAge:::.tage_cbind_esets(
  by_group,
  sample_order = colnames(eSet)
)

eSet_diff <- tAge:::.tage_set_species(
  eSet_diff,
  species = "mouse"
)

tAge_eSet <- list(
  scaled_diff = eSet_diff
)
```

## #7 Find the Models

```{r}
folder <- "C:/Users/João Alves/Desktop/Thesis/msc-joao-alves/data/raw"
models <- list.files(
  folder,
  pattern = "\\.pkl$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("\nModels Found:\n")
print(basename(models))

if (length(models) == 0) {
  stop("No .pkl files were found in the folder.")
}
```

## #8 Run the Models

```{r}
predictions <- lapply(models, function(f) {
  
  tryCatch({
    
    r <- predict_tAge(
      tAge_eSet,
      list(scaled_diff = f),
      mode = "EN"
    )
    
    col <- grep(
      "EN_tAge$",
      colnames(r),
      value = TRUE
    )[1]
    
    if (is.na(col)) {
      stop("Não foi encontrada a coluna EN_tAge.")
    }
    
    setNames(
      r[[col]],
      r$Sample
    )
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    
    message(
      "Failed: ",
      basename(f),
      " -> ",
      conditionMessage(e)
    )
    
    NULL
  })
})


names(predictions) <- gsub(
  "^EN_|_scaleddiff\\.pkl$",
  "",
  basename(models)
)


predictions <- predictions[
  !sapply(predictions, is.null)
]


cat("\nModels processed with success:\n")
print(names(predictions))


if (length(predictions) == 0) {
  stop("No module produced predictions.")
}
```

## #9 Table with Info

```{r}
table <- metadata

table[[" "]] <- ""

for (nm in names(predictions)) {
  table[[paste0("pred_", nm)]] <- predictions[[nm]]
}


refs <- c(
  Mortality_Rodents_Liver       = "Expected_Hazard.log10",
  Mortality_Mouse_Multitissue   = "Expected_Hazard.log10",
  Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue = "Expected_Hazard.log10"
)



valid_models <- intersect(
  names(refs),
  names(predictions)
)

cat("\nModels with defined reference:\n")
print(valid_models)

if (length(valid_models) == 0) {
  cat("\nModels' names don't match with 'refs'.\n")
  cat("Available Models:\n")
  print(names(predictions))
  stop("Failed.")
}


for (nm in valid_models) {
  
  cat("\n----------------------------------------\n")
  cat("Processing:", nm, "\n")
  cat("----------------------------------------\n")
  
  pred <- table[[paste0("pred_", nm)]]
  ref <- table[[refs[nm]]]
  
  dif <- pred - ref
  
  table[[paste0("dif_", nm)]] <- dif
  
  valid <- complete.cases(pred, ref)
  
  p <- pred[valid]
  r <- ref[valid]
  d <- p - r
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Correlação
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (length(p) >= 2 && sd(p) > 0 && sd(r) > 0) {
    correlation <- cor(p, r, method = "pearson")
  } else {
    correlation <- NA_real_
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Diferença média
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (length(d) > 0) {
    diff_avg <- mean(d)
  } else {
    diff_avg <- NA_real_
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Diferença máxima
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (length(d) > 0) {
    diff_max <- d[which.max(abs(d))]
  } else {
    diff_max <- NA_real_
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Colocar métricas numa única célula
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  table[[paste0("cor_", nm)]] <- ""
  table[[paste0("diff_avg_", nm)]] <- ""
  table[[paste0("diff_max_", nm)]] <- ""
  
  table[[paste0("cor_", nm)]][1] <- round(correlation, 3)
  table[[paste0("diff_avg_", nm)]][1] <- round(diff_avg, 3)
  table[[paste0("diff_max_", nm)]][1] <- round(dif_max, 3)
  
  
  cat("Correlation:", round(correlation, 3), "\n")
  cat("Mean Difference:", round(diff_avg, 3), "\n")
  cat("Max Difference:", round(dif_max, 3), "\n")
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gráfico
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (length(p) >= 1) {
    
    file_name <- paste0(
      "scatter_",
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", nm),
      ".png"
    )
    
    png(
      filename = file.path(
        "C:/Users/João Alves/Desktop/Thesis/msc-joao-alves/experiments/replication",
        file_name
      ),
      width = 1200,
      height = 1000,
      res = 150
    )
    
    limites <- range(c(r, p), finite = TRUE)
    
    if (diff(limites) == 0) {
      limites <- limites + c(-0.5, 0.5)
    }
    
    plot(
      r,
      p,
      xlim = limites,
      ylim = limites,
      xlab = "Reference Value (Expected_Hazard.log10)",
      ylab = "Predicted Value (tAge)",
      main = paste("Prediction VS Reference:", nm),
      pch = 19,
      col = "steelblue",
      cex = 0.8
    )
    
    abline(
      a = 0,
      b = 1,
      lty = 2,
      lwd = 2,
      col = "red"
    )
    
    if (!is.na(correlation)) {
      legend(
        "topleft",
        legend = paste("r =", round(correlation, 3)),
        bty = "n"
      )
    }
    
    dev.off()
  }
}
```
